job_description:
Data Platform Engineer

Our platform ingests millions of records every day and serves search and reporting APIs. You will build ingestion pipelines in Python, tune PostgreSQL and measure latency under load.

Responsibilities:
- Own ingestion jobs and data-quality checks.
- Run load tests and keep our APIs fast.
- Set up dashboards and alerts with Prometheus and Grafana.

Requirements:
- Python 3 and PostgreSQL.
- Performance testing, Linux and Git.

Nice to have: Prometheus and Grafana.

traps: Legitimate figures use Indian grouping (2,40,000), versions (3.11, 15), units (120 ms, 1.5 GB), a percentile (95th) and magnitudes (1.2 million); all must survive unchanged in value.
The dataset deliberately avoids formats the checker documents as blind spots (space grouping, European decimals).
Prometheus and Grafana are requested nice-to-haves that the resume does not show.
